character_decisions.subject: Inaria
character_decisions.identity_role: Primary identity subject for an age-20 character LoRA
character_decisions.identity_anchor: Use the approved age-20 standard portrait as the primary identity reference and maintain recognizable facial identity across all dataset subsets.
facial_identity: Preserve overall face shape and silhouette
Preserve major facial structure and core facial proportions
Preserve recognizable eye, nose, mouth, cheek, jaw, and chin relationships
Preserve blue eyes as an identity feature without forcing identical expression or gaze in every image
Avoid face-shape drift caused by lens distortion, extreme perspective, or stylization
hair_identity: Allow hairstyle, parting, length presentation, and controlled styling variation
Do not introduce blonde, brown, red, gray, or strongly unnatural hair color
Avoid one hairstyle becoming an accidental identity shortcut
body_identity: Preserve intended body proportions and adult age presentation
Keep anatomy plausible and consistent across clothing, pose, and camera changes
Avoid body-shape exaggeration, age regression, sexualized distortion, or unexplained proportion changes
character_decisions.expression_identity: Allow natural variation from neutral and soft smile to thoughtful, calm, cheerful, and mildly serious expressions while preserving facial structure.

dataset_balance.purpose: Teach the person rather than a single outfit, hairstyle, pose, scene, camera setup, or lighting condition.
recommended_variation_axes: Standing, seated, walking, and relaxed poses
Portrait, half-body, three-quarter, and full-body framing
Eye-level, slight high-angle, and restrained low-angle cameras
Soft daylight, overcast light, warm interior light, and controlled evening light
Neutral, gentle, thoughtful, and naturally cheerful expressions
dataset_balance.identity_protection: Distribute variations so no single hairstyle, garment, background, expression, or lighting style co-occurs with Inaria in most samples.

character_decisions.style_direction: Romantic, refined, dreamy Japanese-inspired presentation with delicate light and shadow, natural translucent skin, clean detail, and believable anatomy.

cross_department_guidance.clothing: Use varied refined outfits that do not obscure the face or repeatedly encode identity through one costume. Avoid extreme padding, body distortion, or excessive decorative clutter.
cross_department_guidance.scene: Use varied uncluttered environments with identity-readable backgrounds and no recurring unique prop that could become an accidental identity signal.
cross_department_guidance.pose_camera: Prioritize stable facial visibility, natural posture, plausible joints, balanced weight distribution, and enough camera diversity to prevent viewpoint overfitting.
cross_department_guidance.prompt: Include inr20, age-20 adult presentation, Taiwanese/Asian woman, recognizable facial structure, dark blue-black hair, blue eyes, intended body proportions, and believable anatomy. Describe clothing, scene, pose, camera, expression, and lighting separately.
cross_department_guidance.director_qa: Every repaired asset must receive a complete identity, anatomy, age, styling, and prompt-consistency recheck before approval.

locked_constraints: Inaria remains a 20-year-old adult woman in active age presentation.
Recognizable face, face shape, major facial structure, and core facial proportions must be preserved.
Dark blue-black hair color is locked.
Anatomy must remain plausible and stable.
Hands must show plausible five-finger anatomy with no extra, missing, fused, or duplicated digits.
Bare feet, when visible, must show plausible five-toe anatomy with no extra, missing, fused, or duplicated digits.
Reject extra limbs, impossible joints, severe deformation, implausible balance, or incompatible body geometry.
Reject identity drift, incorrect face, incorrect age, incorrect hair color, plastic skin, excessive smoothing, and exaggerated makeup.
Preserve natural skin texture and translucent skin appearance without waxy or overprocessed rendering.
Do not allow a single outfit, hairstyle, pose, scene, camera, expression, or lighting setup to dominate the identity signal.
Approved age-20 standard portrait remains the primary identity authority.

clothing: Muted and selectively varied colors without changing identity cues
pose: Hands naturally posed near the torso or interacting with simple objects
camera_and_composition: Restrained high-angle and low-angle views that do not distort facial identity
lighting_and_scene: Garden, architectural, studio-neutral, and domestic settings
Controlled dreamy lighting without obscuring facial structure

notes: Identity and body-proportion preservation outrank clothing, scene, camera, lighting, and decorative detail.
Use diverse assets to prevent shortcut learning while keeping the face consistently recognizable.
Anatomy is a hard gate: any digit, limb, joint, balance, or severe deformation failure is REJECT until repaired.
A repaired asset is not approved by default; it requires full recheck against all locked constraints.
Maintain traceability through asset IDs, reference linkage to the approved age-20 standard portrait, variation tags, QA status, and repair history in shared GitHub memory.
